description: Fix the frontend vitest failure and its cascade by hardening every undefined-array read in the reworked provider/model-selector UI at the source (component + store), and align test IPC mocks with the new command/return shapes. ROOT CAUSE: ProviderKeysSection's mount effect does listCloudProviders().then((next) => setProviders(next)) with no guard; in src/app.test.tsx the routeInvoke switch has no 'list_cloud_providers' case, so invoke resolves undefined, setProviders(undefined) makes providers undefined, and `providers.length > 0` throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)'. Settings defaults to the Providers section, so navigating to Settings mounts ProviderKeysSection; the thrown error tears down the render and also fails src/app.test.tsx > <App> > 'switches to the History and Settings destinations'. Fix defensively so the REAL app cannot hit the same undefined at runtime, and make the app.test mock well-formed. This is a single coherent fix; run all feasible verification (prettier at minimum; vitest/tsc/eslint only if node_modules is somehow available).
steps: In hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/features/settings/ProviderKeysSection.tsx: guard every IPC-array assignment against a non-array/undefined resolve. In the mount useEffect, change `.then((next) => setProviders(next))` to `.then((next) => setProviders(Array.isArray(next) ? next : []))`. Apply the same `Array.isArray(next) ? next : []` guard to the clearProvider path's `.then((next) => setProviders(next))`. Do NOT remove the existing `.catch(() => setProviders([]))`. Leave the `providers.length > 0` / `providers.map(...)` render as-is once the state is guaranteed to be an array. Keep all existing behavior and comments; keep imports used.

In hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/features/settings/LocalRuntimesSection.tsx: apply the same source-level hardening so a backend/test resolving undefined cannot crash. In the mount useEffect, guard `listLocalRuntimes().then((next) => setRuntimes(next))` -> `setRuntimes(Array.isArray(next) ? next : [])`, and `listEmbeddedModels().then((next) => setEmbeddedModels(next))` -> `setEmbeddedModels(Array.isArray(next) ? next : [])`. Apply the same guard to the clearRuntime path's `.then((next) => setRuntimes(next))` and to the importModel/loadPath `.then((next) => setEmbeddedModels(next))` assignments. Keep existing .catch fallbacks. Keep behavior/comments intact.

In hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/features/model-selector/ProviderEnumerationErrors.tsx: make the component robust to an undefined/non-array `errors` prop (it is rendered in both ProviderKeysSection and PerMessageOverrideControl). At the top of the function, normalize: `const items = Array.isArray(errors) ? errors : [];` then use `items` for the `.length === 0` guard and the `.map(...)`. Do not change the props type (it stays ProviderEnumerationError[]).

In hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/features/model-selector/ProviderModelPicker.tsx: make the `models` prop reads robust. Normalize at the top of each function that reads `models` (the exported picker and any helper): `const list = Array.isArray(models) ? models : [];` and use `list` for `.length` / `.map` / `.filter`. Keep the existing grouping (local vs cloud) and empty-state behavior identical.

In hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/state/providers.ts: leave load() as-is (it already defaults `result.models ?? []` and `result.errors ?? []`). Do NOT weaken the store defaults (models: [], errors: []).

In hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/app.test.tsx: make the IPC mock well-formed for the new command shapes so the App-level Settings render is realistic. In the routeInvoke switch, add a case that returns [] for the provider/runtime listing commands the mounted Settings tree calls: 'list_cloud_providers', 'list_local_runtimes', 'list_embedded_models'. Add a case for 'embedded_model_status' returning { loadedModelId: null, registeredCount: 0 }. Keep the existing 'list_available_models' case returning { models: [], errors: [] }. Keep the default:-> undefined branch for genuinely-unused commands. This aligns the App test with the reworked Settings without masking the source-level guards (the guards are the primary fix).

Verify no unused imports/vars were introduced (eslint no-unused-vars) and that changes are prettier-clean (2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas matching the existing files). Do not touch any Rust file.

Run available verification: from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend try `NODE_OPTIONS= npx vitest run`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx eslint .`, `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .`. If node_modules/npm is unavailable (expected under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY), record that they could not run and instead re-read every changed file and trace each array access to confirm it reads an always-array value. Report exactly which tools ran vs were reasoned.
acceptance_criteria: ProviderKeysSection never reads .length/.map on undefined: providers state is always an array even when listCloudProviders() resolves undefined or rejects.

src/app.test.tsx > <App> > 'switches to the History and Settings destinations' no longer fails: navigating to Settings mounts ProviderKeysSection without throwing, so findByRole('navigation', {name:'Settings sections'}) resolves.
No React unhandled error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' is thrown from <ProviderKeysSection> during any test.
settings.test.tsx suite still passes: cloud provider registration via set_cloud_provider, base-URL-required for Kiro, warning display, and rehydration-across-remount behaviors are unchanged.
ProviderEnumerationErrors and ProviderModelPicker tolerate undefined/non-array inputs without throwing while preserving existing rendered output for valid arrays.
No unused imports/vars (eslint) and no prettier diffs introduced; no Rust files changed.
verification: From hybrid-orchestrator/frontend: npx vitest run passes the full suite (or, if unrunnable offline, a careful trace confirms every array access reads an always-array value and app.test navigation to Settings cannot throw).
npx tsc --noEmit reports no type errors (or reasoned equivalent).
npx eslint . reports no errors (or reasoned equivalent).
NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check . reports no formatting issues (run if the prettier binary is available).
findings: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED: app.test.tsx routeInvoke had no 'list_cloud_providers' case -> invoke resolves undefined -> ProviderKeysSection mount effect setProviders(undefined) -> `providers.length > 0` threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)'; Settings defaults to Providers section so the 'switches to the History and Settings destinations' test mounted ProviderKeysSection and the throw tore down the render (cascade). FIXES: (1) ProviderKeysSection.tsx - guarded mount `listCloudProviders().then((next)=>setProviders(Array.isArray(next)?next:[]))` and clearProvider's `.then((next)=>setProviders(Array.isArray(next)?next:[]))`; existing .catch(()=>setProviders([])) kept. (2) LocalRuntimesSection.tsx - guarded 4 assignments: mount listLocalRuntimes+listEmbeddedModels, clearRuntime's listLocalRuntimes refresh, importModel setEmbeddedModels, and loadPath setEmbeddedModels. (3) ProviderEnumerationErrors.tsx - normalized `const items = Array.isArray(errors)?errors:[]` for .length/.map (props type unchanged). (4) ProviderModelPicker.tsx - normalized `const list = Array.isArray(models)?models:[]` in BOTH ModelGroup and the exported picker, used for .length/.map/.filter. (5) app.test.tsx routeInvoke - added cases returning [] for list_cloud_providers/list_local_runtimes/list_embedded_models and { loadedModelId: null, registeredCount: 0 } for embedded_model_status; kept list_available_models -> {models:[],errors:[]} and default -> undefined. HARDENED UNDEFINED-ARRAY READS: providers (ProviderKeysSection x2 paths), runtimes (LocalRuntimesSection mount+clear), embeddedModels (LocalRuntimesSection mount+import+select), errors (ProviderEnumerationErrors), models (ProviderModelPicker group+picker), plus test IPC mock aligned. CASCADE RESOLVED: Settings->Providers now mounts ProviderKeysSection with providers always [] (both via source guard and well-formed mock), so no throw; findByRole('navigation',{name:'Settings sections'}) resolves. Store providers.ts left as-is (already ?? []). VERIFICATION: prettier ran locally and reports ALL 5 changed files clean. vitest could NOT run (npm E403 for @vitest under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, node_modules absent). tsc could NOT run (missing /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js preload). eslint not runnable (node_modules absent). Correctness for tsc/eslint/vitest was verified by careful re-read/trace: no unused vars introduced (param names still referenced by Array.isArray), EmbeddedModelStatus type in types/index.ts is { loadedModelId: string|null; registeredCount: number } matching the mock, and all normalization preserves output for valid arrays so existing settings/model-selector/agent-editor tests are unaffected. No Rust files touched. OUT-OF-SCOPE steering ideas flagged (not implemented): OAuth/connect-login instead of pasting a key; folder-pick auto-discovery of local AI for embedded browse; LAN-host mode for other devices to use this agent's models.
